note: Curated, hand-reviewed records. Status of each capability on this machine (approved, available, invoked, validated) is computed at read time, never stored here. Sources pinned to commits from docs/research/instagram-2026-10.ledger.json (private development history; not in this repository).

capabilities.title: Verify the change
capabilities.description: What the current change can break and which tests show it; `--run` runs them in a sandbox.
capabilities.executes_repo_code: only with `repo-ai verify --run` (sandboxed; its own approval)

overhead.runtime: plan: about 1 s; --run: the selected tests

limitations: the plan is static; only `--run` executes tests
needs a recognised test runner
native_alternatives: Claude Code can run the test suite itself
bundled /verify skill builds and runs the app
capabilities.adds_beyond_native: selects only the tests the change can affect and records sandboxed evidence tied to the exact diff

capabilities.title: Change impact
capabilities.description: Importers, tests and co-changed files reachable from changed paths or a symbol.

overhead.runtime: under 1 s on an indexed repository

limitations: import-graph based: dynamic dispatch and reflection are missed
needs `repo-ai init`
native_alternatives: Claude Code LSP tool when a language-server plugin is installed
capabilities.adds_beyond_native: transitive importers, linked tests and co-change history in one answer

capabilities.title: Task context shortlist
capabilities.description: Ranks the files most relevant to a task description.

evidence.agent_benefit: tied with plain search in recorded trials

limitations: lexical and structural ranking; no embeddings
capabilities.adds_beyond_native: little: recorded trials found it tied with plain search, so it is offered only when asked for a shortlist

capabilities.title: Change passport
capabilities.description: Pre-PR evidence packet: what the diff touches, linked tests, risks and blind spots.
limitations: static; it does not judge correctness
capabilities.fallback: git diff --stat and reading the diff
capabilities.adds_beyond_native: deterministic facts about the diff (tests linked, secrets on added lines, untested paths); no model call

capabilities.title: Vet a skill or plugin before installing
capabilities.description: Pins a GitHub URL (or reads a local directory) and statically inspects its skills and plugin components.

refs: docs/research/vet-eval-2026-10.md (private development history; not in this repository)

limitations: static: a clean result is not proof of safety
31% of held-out blocks were false positives
capabilities.fallback: read the repository yourself before installing
capabilities.adds_beyond_native: pins the commit, inspects content and records the exact hash an install must match

capabilities.title: Audit installed skills, hooks and MCP servers
capabilities.description: Everything Claude Code loads here, whoever installed it, with firewall findings and context cost.

refs: docs/research/vet-eval-2026-10.md (private development history; not in this repository)

limitations: static
reads only the files Claude Code documents
capabilities.adds_beyond_native: one read-only view with content inspection, unpinned-server and listing-budget warnings

capabilities.title: Context budget
capabilities.description: Always-loaded and per-prompt context repo-ai adds, against limits.
limitations: token counts are estimates
capabilities.adds_beyond_native: per-source accounting of what repo-ai itself adds, with a CI-friendly --check

capabilities.title: Python security lint on the change (ruff S rules)
capabilities.description: Runs an approved local ruff with a curated set of flake8-bandit rules on the changed Python files and reports findings on added lines as SARIF.
capabilities.provider: Astral ruff (local install), adapter by repo-ai
capabilities.executes_repo_code: no (ruff parses, never runs, the code)

activation.approval: repo-ai capabilities approve (binds path + sha256 + version)

overhead.runtime: well under 1 s for tens of files

capabilities.maintenance: ruff is actively maintained; the rule subset is repo-ai's
limitations: pattern lint, not dataflow SAST: authorization, CSRF and logic flaws are invisible to it
Python only
the rule subset trades recall for noise
capabilities.fallback: /security-review (model review) or a full SAST tool
capabilities.adds_beyond_native: deterministic, offline findings scoped to the lines this change adds; a failed scan is reported as a failure, never as clean

capabilities.title: Multi-language SAST (Semgrep CE)
capabilities.description: Dataflow-aware static analysis with SARIF output for JS/TS, Go, Java, Python and more.
capabilities.network: rule registry downloads unless local rules and --metrics=off
limitations: not installed here; no adapter yet
registry rules need network
capabilities.adds_beyond_native: deterministic dataflow findings for languages ruff does not cover

capabilities.title: Vulnerable dependency audit
capabilities.description: pip-audit, npm audit or osv-scanner against the lockfiles the change touches.
limitations: queries an online advisory database
not installed here; no adapter yet
capabilities.fallback: npm audit (ships with npm) or the platform's Dependabot alerts
capabilities.adds_beyond_native: scoped to the manifests this change touches; nothing native audits dependencies

capabilities.title: Precise references and rename (language server)
capabilities.description: Claude Code's LSP tool through an official language-server plugin (pyright-lsp, typescript-lsp, gopls-lsp …).
capabilities.provider: Anthropic official plugins (claude-plugins-official); Serena is the GPL-3.0 alternative
capabilities.network: none at runtime; installing the server binary is yours

activation.method: Claude Code plugin (you install it with /plugin; repo-ai never does)

review.ref: docs/research/CAPABILITY-DECISIONS-2026-10.md (private development history; not in this repository)

limitations: needs the language server binary on PATH
Serena (oraios/serena@abb0a0f) is GPL-3.0: interop only, never vendored
native_alternatives: this is the native mechanism; repo-ai only points at it
capabilities.adds_beyond_native: nothing beyond native; recommended because plain Grep misses aliased and re-exported symbols

capabilities.title: Browser runtime evidence (Chrome DevTools MCP)
capabilities.description: Console errors, network, performance traces and screenshots for front-end changes, from an isolated browser profile.
capabilities.network: the pages you open; usage statistics are ON by default (use --no-usage-statistics --no-performance-crux)

activation.method: an MCP server you add yourself, pinned to a reviewed version, isolated and with usage statistics off (docs/CAPABILITIES.md)

review.ref: docs/research/CAPABILITY-DECISIONS-2026-10.md (private development history; not in this repository)

limitations: not installed here
never connect it to your personal browser profile
capabilities.fallback: Claude Code's Chrome integration (uses your logged-in profile) or manual checking
capabilities.removal: remove the MCP server entry you added
capabilities.adds_beyond_native: isolated or headless profile, Lighthouse and performance traces

capabilities.title: Mutation testing
capabilities.description: Measures whether the tests would catch a change (mutmut for Python, Stryker for JS/TS, mewt via Trail of Bits).
capabilities.provider: mutmut / Stryker / Trail of Bits mutation-testing skill

activation.method: not implemented; a future adapter needs repo-ai's verify engine

review.ref: docs/research/CAPABILITY-DECISIONS-2026-10.md (private development history; not in this repository)

limitations: slow
Trail of Bits skills are CC-BY-SA-4.0: pointer only, never vendored
capabilities.fallback: repo-ai.verify (which tests are linked) and coverage
capabilities.adds_beyond_native: a direct measure of test strength that nothing native provides

capabilities.title: Property-based testing
capabilities.description: Hypothesis or fast-check tests for invariants, round-trips and edge cases.
capabilities.provider: Hypothesis / fast-check / proptest; Trail of Bits property-based-testing skill
permissions: executes repository code when tests run

activation.method: a test library you add as a dev dependency

review.ref: docs/research/CAPABILITY-DECISIONS-2026-10.md (private development history; not in this repository)

limitations: not installed here
the skill is prompt-only
native_alternatives: Claude can write property tests if the library is present
capabilities.adds_beyond_native: generated inputs find edge cases example tests miss

capabilities.title: Differential security review workflow
capabilities.description: Trail of Bits' structured security review of a diff (threat-model the change, then check each class).
permissions: model time (it is a prompt workflow)

activation.method: a skill you vet (repo-ai skills vet) and install yourself

review.ref: docs/research/vet-eval-2026-10.md (private development history; not in this repository)

limitations: prompt-only; no enforcement
CC-BY-SA-4.0: pointer only
capabilities.adds_beyond_native: a more structured checklist than /security-review; benefit unmeasured
